event_detail: Drawer: the gripper moves around the drawer handles (up close to a handle at 30.4 s) but never pulls a drawer; at 32.0 s the arm swings away to the right with the drawers still closed.
evidence: Shoulder views show the drawer fronts under the counter closed in all four frames. The wrist camera sees handles from different angles, comes very close to one drawer front at 30.4 s, then at 32.0 s views the whole drawer stack from further away, all drawers closed. The gripper holds nothing and the glass by the plant has no straw. It may still be repositioning for another try, so this is not certain.
